# Prepare

```{python}
# Setup code
import pandas as pd
from python_scripts import setup
from python_scripts import services
from python_scripts import helper
from python_scripts import routes
df, dffp = setup.setup(verbose=False)

from python_scripts import distinct_pathways
dpw_pls = distinct_pathways.get_distinct_pathways_routes(dffp)
qrows = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] == "[Not ended or invalid end reason]"
dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls.pl_end_dt > distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt, ["pl_end_dt", "pl_end_reason", "dur"]] = pd.NA
dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "pl_end_dt"].isna().map({True: "[Not ended]", False: "Missing data/error"})
dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"].str.replace("To care/hosp.", "To care/hospital")
dpw_rt_starts = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").head(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1)  # 1 duplicate client but first entry has more detailed answers

import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (6.2, 4.1),
    'font.size': 12,
    'figure.constrained_layout.use': True
})

from IPython.display import Markdown

asset_themes = {"opaque": "assets_output/",
                "transparent_lightbg": "assets_transparent_lightbg/",
                "transparent_darkbg": "assets_transparent_darkbg/"}
assets_output = asset_themes["opaque"]
output_dir = assets_output
transparent = False
excel_output = {}
dpw_pls_orig = dpw_pls
odds_r_tables = []
figure_major_i = 9
figure_minor_i = 0
# Alpha
alpha = 0.05

rt_outcomes_map = {
    'Independent accommodation': ['To social housing', 'To private rented'],
    'Insecure outcome': ['To friends/family', 'Custody', 'To care/hospital', 'To external supported'],
    'Returned to homelessness': ['Evicted', 'Abandoned'],
    'Died': ['Died'],
    # '_excluded': ['Other', 'Missing data/error']
}
rt_end_cat_map = {cat: outcome for outcome in rt_outcomes_map.keys() for cat in rt_outcomes_map[outcome]}

```

## Set up networks

```{python}# Set up networks
from python_scripts import networks
from python_scripts import network_graphs
import itertools

extant = dpw_pls.groupby("o_cli_id").head(1)[
    lambda x: x.pl_start_dt < distinct_pathways.dpw_start_dt
]
network_list = [
    {"title": "all", "df": dpw_pls},
    {"title": "women", "df": dpw_pls[dpw_pls.gender == "Female"]},
    {"title": "men", "df": dpw_pls[dpw_pls.gender == "Male"]},
    {
        "title": "people with 1 route who moved to stable housing at least 6 months ago and did not return " +
                 "(excluding people already in services on 28 Oct 2017)",
        "df": dpw_pls[
            (dpw_pls.groupby('o_cli_id').route_id.transform("nunique") == 1) &  # 1 route
            dpw_pls.rt_end_cat.isin(["To social housing", "To private rented"]) &  # These outcomes
            (dpw_pls.after_rt_ret_within_6m == "No") &  # No return within 6 months
            (~dpw_pls.o_cli_id.isin(extant.o_cli_id))  # Not already in services
        ]
    },
    {
        "title": "people who moved to private/social housing at least 6 months before end date and did not return " +
                 "(excluding people already in services on start date)",
        "df": dpw_pls[
            dpw_pls.rt_end_cat.isin(["To social housing", "To private rented"]) &  # These outcomes
            (dpw_pls.after_rt_ret_within_6m == "No") &  # No return within 6 months
            (~dpw_pls.o_cli_id.isin(extant.o_cli_id))  # Not already in services
        ]
    },
    # {
    #     "title": "people whose first placement was after October 2022 " +
    #              "(excluding people already in services on 28 Oct 2017)",
    #     "df": dpw_pls[dpw_pls.groupby("o_cli_id").pl_start_dt.transform(lambda x: x.head(1)) > pd.Timestamp("2021-10-28")]
    # }
]
DGs = []
min_n = 3
nt = "svc_typelvl"
for i in network_list:
    title_i, df_i = (i.get(key) for key in ["title", "df"])
    df_i = df_i[df_i["rt_end_cat"] != "Missing data/error"]
    # sorted_end_cats = distinct_pathways.get_sorted_end_cats(df_i)
    sorted_end_cats = { k: v for k, v in list(zip(list(rt_outcomes_map.keys()) + ["Other"], itertools.count())) }
    adj_list_i, edge_list_i = networks.mkAdjEdgeLists(dffp, df_i, [nt])
    edge_list_i[nt] = edge_list_i[nt].replace(rt_end_cat_map).groupby(["source", "target"]).sum().reset_index()
    i["edge_list"] = edge_list_i
    excel_output[f"Edge list: {title_i}"] = adj_list_i
    adj_list_i[nt] = adj_list_i[nt].replace(rt_end_cat_map).groupby(["source", "target"]).sum().reset_index()
    i["adj_list"] = adj_list_i
    excel_output[f"Adjacency list: {title_i}"] = adj_list_i
    DG = network_graphs.mkDgraph(edge_list_i[nt], title=title_i, threshold=0.07,
                                 min_n=min_n, sorted_end_cats=sorted_end_cats, capacities=distinct_pathways.capacities,
                                 individuals=df_i.o_cli_id.nunique())
    DGs.append(DG)
    i["DG_proportions"] = DG
    DG = network_graphs.mkDgraph(adj_list_i[nt], title=title_i, threshold=(0.020 * adj_list_i[nt].weight.max()),
                                 min_n=min_n, sorted_end_cats=sorted_end_cats, capacities=distinct_pathways.capacities,
                                 individuals=df_i.o_cli_id.nunique())
    DGs.append(DG)
    i["DG_counts"] = DG
```

## Sankey

```{python}
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
import itertools
import random
from collections import defaultdict
sns.set()

el = network_list[0]["edge_list"][nt]
el["source"] = (el["source"].mask(el["source"].isin(["Known (adult pw)", "Known (other)", "New", "_RETURN"]),
                                  "Into " + el["target"].str.extract(r"^([A-Z/]+)", expand=False)))
el = el[(~el["source"].isin(["EXTANT", "ENTRY"])) & (~el["target"].isin(["END", "RETURN"]))]
el = el.groupby(["source", "target"]).sum().reset_index().drop(columns="weight")

idx_node = { k: v for (k, v) in zip(itertools.count(), pd.concat([el["source"], el["target"]]).unique()) }
node_idx = { v: k for (k, v) in idx_node.items() }

el_idx = el.replace(node_idx)

p_x = dict(f=0.5, m=3, mf=1.7, su=4.3)
pos = {
 'F L1': (p_x["f"]-0.05, 1.5), 'F L2': (p_x["f"]+0.1, 2.5), 'F L3': (p_x["f"]+0.2, 3.5), 'F L4': (p_x["f"]+0.3, 4.5),
 'Into F': (1, 0.5), 'Into M': (3.2, 0.5), 'Into M/F': (1.9, 0.5), 'Into SU': (4.5, 0.5),
 'M L1': (p_x["m"], 1.5), 'M L2': (p_x["m"]+0.3, 2.5), 'M L3': (p_x["m"], 3.5), 'M L4': (p_x["m"]-0.2, 4.5),
 'M/F L1': (p_x["mf"], 1.5), 'M/F L2': (p_x["mf"], 2.5), 'M/F L3': (p_x["mf"], 3.5), 'M/F L4': (p_x["mf"]+0.05, 4.5),
 'SU L1': (p_x["su"], 2), 'SU L2': (p_x["su"]+0.25, 3),
 'Died': (4.999, 5.5), 'Independent accommodation': (0.5, 5.5), 'Insecure outcome': (1.9, 5.5),
 'Other': (4.5, 5.5), 'Returned to homelessness': (3.5, 5.5),
}

into_nodes = [v for (k, v) in node_idx.items() if k.startswith("Into")]
exit_nodes = [v for (k, v) in node_idx.items() if k in sorted_end_cats.keys()]
node_labels = list(node_idx.keys())
colours = sns.color_palette(n_colors=len(node_idx) - len(exit_nodes) - len(into_nodes) + 1)
colours = np.round([[x*256 for x in colour] for colour in colours]).astype("int")
r, g, b = colours[0]
node_colour = f"rgba({r},{g},{b},0.9)" 
colours = [f"rgba({r},{g},{b},0.5)" for r, g, b in colours]
grey = 'rgba(141,141,141,0.5)'
colours.remove(grey)
transparent = "rgba(0,0,0,0.0)"
node_colours_map = defaultdict(lambda: "rgba(90,90,90,0.9)")
for i in sorted(into_nodes):
    colours.insert(i, grey)
    node_colours_map[i] = grey
for i in sorted(exit_nodes):
    colours.insert(i, transparent)
    node_colours_map[i] = grey
node_colours = [node_colours_map[x] for x in idx_node.keys()]

source = el_idx["source"]
target = el_idx["target"]
value = el_idx["n"] * 0.5
colour = el_idx["source"].apply(lambda x: colours[x])
label = []

fig = go.Figure(data=[go.Sankey(
    node=dict(
      align="left",
      pad=15,
      thickness=25,
      line=dict(width=0),
      label=node_labels,
      color=node_colours,
      x=[x/6 for (y, x) in [pos[i] for i in node_idx]],
      y=[y/5 for (y, x) in [pos[i] for i in node_idx]],
    ),
    link=dict(source=source, target=target, value=value, color=colour, label=label),
    orientation="v"
)])
fig.update_layout(font_family="Arial", font_weight=750, font_color="white")

fig_filename = assets_output + "Figure_15.1.svg"
fig_filename_png = assets_output + "Figure_15.1.png"
fig.write_image(fig_filename, width=1268, height=1297)
fig.write_image(fig_filename_png, width=1268, height=1297)
with Image.open(fig_filename_png) as im:
    im.show()
# fig.show()

```
# Tables in an Excel file

```{python}
#| output: asis
import os
sheetname = "Sheet1"
qmdfile = os.getenv("QUARTO_DOCUMENT_FILE")
filename = assets_output + qmdfile[:-4]+".xlsx"
with pd.ExcelWriter(filename) as writer:
    next_row = 0
    for k, v in excel_output.items():
        pd.DataFrame([k]).to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheetname, header=False, index=False, startrow=next_row)
        next_row += 1
        v.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheetname, startrow=next_row)
        next_row += (
            (1 if not isinstance(v.columns, pd.MultiIndex) else 1 + len(v.columns.levels))
            + len(v) + 1)
    float_format = writer.book.add_format({"num_format": "#,##0.000"})
    writer.sheets[sheetname].set_column("B:J", None, float_format)
print(f"[Excel file](./{filename})")
```
